review_type: Independent qualitative visual/source review; not manufacturing approval
reviewer_role: Source-inspection subtask, separate from geometry authoring and manufacturing QA
review_scope: Four original public photos and all nine actual v2 PNGs were directly inspected with view_image. Earlier v1 top was only a temporary layout reference, superseded by direct v2 top inspection.
assessment: The supported central higher mass, long wings and vertical end blocks, terrace roofs, truncated roof and gabled entrance remain readable for a low-detail representative candidate. No observed scope collision with 04 or neighbors; no pointed-pyramid roof substitution. This is not a dimensionally accurate reconstruction.
manifest_geometry_statement: The render manifest declares unmodified imported STL triangles. This visual review independently checked file hashes, not triangle geometry or manufacture.

preview_file_bindings.observed: Central taller mass, paired long wings, vertical end blocks, terrace roofs, flat-topped orange roof and projecting gable entrance remain readable.
preview_file_bindings.limits: Facade bands, open undercroft, small side roofs and deep entrance structures are regularized into solid mass or shallow relief.

preview_file_bindings.observed: Central rear core and long wings agree at silhouette level; no separate low 04 is included.
preview_file_bindings.limits: Lower rear is obscured in the 640x480 source. Continuous walls and regular windows are envelope estimates.

preview_file_bindings.observed: The central higher facade, lower wings and centered gable entrance remain identifiable.
preview_file_bindings.limits: The filled gable is faint in the pale render; real deep porch, side roofs, vertical facade piers, deep horizontal bands and lettering are omitted or simplified.

preview_file_bindings.observed: Central taller core and continuous wing silhouette remain consistent.
preview_file_bindings.limits: Regular lower rear windows and symmetry are not directly verified from the partially occluded source.

preview_file_bindings.observed: End vertical block silhouette and entrance projection are visible.
preview_file_bindings.limits: The six horizontal recesses are symbolic. The real open end-column/stair frame is filled; neither slot count nor depth is an as-built measurement.

preview_file_bindings.observed: The other vertical end block stays within the main long-wing envelope.
preview_file_bindings.limits: No exact orthographic source; approximate symmetry and end-face openings are not verified dimensions or actual floor counts.

preview_file_bindings.observed: Long main bar, central chamfered roof and paired flat terraces are present. Gray flat top clearly prevents a complete pyramid.
preview_file_bindings.limits: Exact cut corners, plateau size, setbacks, footprint and symmetry are estimates. Vegetation, railings, plant and pergolas are omitted.

preview_file_bindings.observed: Only the central roof is lifted; body, end blocks and entrance remain one part, giving two physical print parts for one model set.
preview_file_bindings.limits: Illustrative exploded placement does not prove fit tolerance, bonding or successful assembly.

preview_file_bindings.observed: Both assembled and roof-lifted views were visually inspected. Text says one set, two parts, 30 mm lift and roof assembly at (0,0,85) mm.
preview_file_bindings.limits: This expresses the conceptual flat glue joint and placement only, not a test print or physical fit validation.

retained_limitations: All millimeter dimensions, wing lengths/depths, symmetry, roof cut corners and plateau sizes are relative photo estimates or manufacturing choices; no survey scale.
Regularized facade windows and six end slots do not represent actual floor counts, window counts or exact bay layout.

The real open end-column/stair frame, deep porch, horizontal recesses and undercroft are solidified or reduced to shallow relief. Filled gable appearance is weaker than the source and must be disclosed.
Rear lower walls are occluded in P3 and side views lack exact orthographic sources; infill is only within the seen envelope, not a verified wall reconstruction.
Small sloping side roofs, railings, equipment, pergolas, planting and lettering are omitted; terrace tint is a display material.
Low 04, parking structures, other neighboring buildings, gate, guardhouse, sculpture, roads, trees and courts are excluded.
Photo capture dates remain unknown; this review does not claim 2026 current appearance.
Two-piece exploded and assembly views do not establish actual fit, glue strength, printability or physical test-print completion.
